description_expanded: ABOUT SHIMMERING PEARL Welcome to Shimmering Pearl, a luxurious coastal retreat located in the sought-after Hadley's Beach area of Panama City Beach, Florida. This impressive 5-bedroom, 6.5-bathroom private home comfortably accommodates up to 24 guests, offering the perfect blend of space, comfort, and upscale beach living. Just a short walk from the beach, this home features Gulf views, a private pool, outdoor kitchen, garage parking, and multiple indoor and outdoor living areas ideal for entertaining and relaxing. Inside, you'll find Smart TVs, WiFi, a convenient coffee bar, an elevator, and elegant furnishings designed to elevate your stay. Each bedroom includes a private ensuite bathroom, providing comfort and privacy for every guest. A spacious queen bunk room offers flexible sleeping arrangements, while additional bathrooms throughout the home add convenience for large groups. From sunrise coffee on the balcony to evenings spent poolside under the stars, Shimmering Pearl offers a refined and memorable beach getaway for every occasion. ABOUT THE AREA Shimmering Pearl is located in Hadley's Beach, a peaceful and desirable section of Panama City Beach, known for its relaxed atmosphere, easy beach access, and stunning Gulf views. This location offers the perfect balance of tranquility and proximity to area attractions. Nearby attractions include: * Direct beach access just minutes away * Local dining and beachside restaurants * St. Andrews State Park * Dolphin tours & fishing charters * Paddleboarding & kayak rentals * Family attractions, shopping, and entertainment Enjoy quiet beach days, sunset strolls, and everything Panama City Beach has to offer - all from your private retreat at Shimmering Pearl. PROPERTY HIGHLIGHTS * Gulf & Beach Views * Less Than 5-Minute Walk to the Beach * Private Pool * Outdoor Kitchen & Outdoor Shower * Elevator * Walkout Balconies * Multiple Indoor & Outdoor Living Spaces * Smart TVs & WiFi * Coffee Bar * Luxury Furnishings & Décor PARKING * 5 Designated Parking Spaces * Garage + driveway parking available PROPERTY RULES * Must be 25 years or older to book * Maximum occupancy: 24 guests * Smoking is not permitted * Rental agreement must be signed within 48 hours of booking or reservation is subject to cancellation * All reservations are non-refundable - travel insurance is strongly encouraged * Property management is not responsible for nearby construction ABOUT PARADISE PROPERTIES When you book your vacation in Florida's Panhandle with Paradise Properties Vacation Rentals and Sales, you can expect first-class service from inquiry to checkout. All homes are professionally cleaned, inspected, and maintained to the highest standards. Our local team is available 24/7 to ensure your stay is seamless and stress-free. Our mission is to help you create unforgettable memories - one beach vacation at a time.

Location: Less Than a 5 Minute Walk to the Beach
